name: peaking-colours
description: Focus peaking in colour: the list of Custom Menu A > Peaking becomes Off / White / Red / Yellow / Blue (setting 458: 1 Off, 3 White, 2 Red, 4 Yellow, 5 Blue; 3 stays the value after a full reset; Black is gone, a camera that was set to Black shows Red). White is the pinned build's pass. For a colour, new code in Key Line pass 9 writes the colour over the pixels of the picture where the line image is 64 or more, and the combine job gets usGain2 = 0. The colour names are the stock texts of the B&W filter list in all 34 languages. A delta on builds/peaking-menu-names.json: every expect is a byte string of that build. See experiments/2026-11-14-focus-peaking/NOTES.md section 16.
_ram: no new RAM; the new code uses 24 bytes of the ART task's stack
